desc.zh: 从加法倒推到取余，证明边界上的整除检查。
desc.en: Reverse additions into remainders, then prove the boundary divisibility test.

entries.complexity: O(1 + log(max(tx, ty))) time; O(1) auxiliary space

title.zh: 阶乘函数后 K 个零
title.en: Preimage Size of Factorial Zeroes Function

desc.zh: 从 24! 到 25! 的跳跃，推导两个边界之差。
desc.en: Use the jump from 24! to 25! to derive a count from two search boundaries.

entries.complexity: O(log²(k+2)) time; O(1) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 从每个值的失分区间推导差分扫描。
desc.en: Derive a difference scan from each value’s losing rotations.

entries.complexity: O(n) time; O(n) space

title.zh: 使序列递增的最小交换次数
title.en: Minimum Swaps To Make Sequences Increasing

desc.zh: 从一次竖直交换推导保留两种结尾的动态规划。
desc.en: Derive a two-ending dynamic program from vertical swaps.

entries.complexity: O(n) time; O(1) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 从一次擦除看清输赢规则，用异或与奇偶性代替博弈搜索。
desc.en: Explore losing erasures, then replace game search with XOR and parity.

entries.complexity: O(n) time; O(1) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 从一次上车解锁整条线路，推导按乘车数分层的搜索与一次扫描不变量。
desc.en: Unlock an entire route per boarding and derive BFS layers with a scan-once invariant.

entries.complexity: O(M + R) expected time; O(M + R) auxiliary space, M = total route entries, R = route count

desc.zh: 从完整状态的分层搜索，推导乐观下界并用 A* 减少探索。
desc.en: Derive an optimistic bound from full-state BFS and prioritize exploration with A*.

entries.complexity: O(D * 2^D) time; O(2^D) space, conservative unit-cost bounds for optimal command depth D; heap work O(Q log Q) for Q generated entries

desc.zh: 给岛编号，用不同邻岛的面积求一次翻转的收益。
desc.en: Label islands and combine distinct neighboring areas for one flip.

entries.complexity: O(n²) time; O(n²) auxiliary space

title.zh: 统计所有子串中的唯一字符
title.en: Count Unique Characters of All Substrings of a Given String

desc.zh: 从 ABA 的六个子串，推导每个字符位置的贡献。
desc.en: Derive occurrence contributions from the six substrings of ABA.

entries.complexity: O(n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 减掉递增的台阶，用长度与整除条件数出正整数序列。
desc.en: Remove the increasing offsets, then count lengths with an equal-sharing test.

entries.complexity: O(sqrt(n)) time; O(1) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 切开一条边，数清变近和变远的节点，推导线性换根算法。
desc.en: Cut one edge, count who gets closer or farther, and derive linear rerooting.

entries.complexity: O(n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 从一次交换到连通分组，推导并查集的不变量。
desc.en: From one swap to connected groups: derive the disjoint-set invariant.

entries.complexity: O(n²(L + log n)) time; O(n) auxiliary space, for n words of length L (conservative bound)

desc.zh: 用逐位匹配排除候选，再用最坏回复桶选择提问。
desc.en: Filter by positional matches and choose guesses by worst reply buckets.

entries.complexity: O(n²L + Gn²) time; O(n²) auxiliary space, L=6 and G≤n (worst-case O(n³+n²L) time)

title.zh: 访问所有节点的最短路径

desc.zh: 从重复经过中心的星形走法，推导记录当前位置与访问集合的多起点搜索。
desc.en: Derive a search over current nodes and visited sets from a walk that revisits a star’s center.

entries.complexity: O((n+m)2^n) expected time; O(n2^n) auxiliary space, m = undirected edges

desc.zh: 把重叠矩形切成竖条，用区间合并计算覆盖高度。
desc.en: Slice overlapping rectangles into strips and merge their covered heights.

entries.complexity: O(n² log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

title.en: Delete Columns to Make Sorted III

desc.zh: 从共享列的兼容关系推导最长保留链。
desc.en: Derive a longest kept chain from shared-column compatibility.

entries.complexity: O(nm²) time; O(m) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 从三节点覆盖实验推导后序遍历的三种状态与最少摄像头。
desc.en: Derive three postorder states from a tiny camera coverage experiment.

entries.complexity: O(n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 把无限循环小数变成精确分数，辨认不同写法背后的同一个数。
desc.en: Turn repeating decimals into exact fractions and compare different spellings.

entries.complexity: O(n) parsing time; O(n) auxiliary space under the official bounded-digit arithmetic model

desc.zh: 从强制跳跃推导排序、栈与双状态倒推。
desc.en: Derive sorted targets and two-state reachability from forced jumps.

entries.complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

desc.zh: 从提前到达终点的失败，推导覆盖每个格子的回溯计数。
desc.en: Derive complete-walk backtracking from an early arrival that fails.

entries.complexity: O(mn + 3^V) time; O(V) auxiliary space, V non-obstacle cells
